bullish.reason: 過去 10 年年化報酬率超越市場 4.78%，強化了投資人對該公司長期價值創造能力的信心。

bullish.title: NetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) Clears Minervini Trend Template and High Growth Momentum, but Setup Quality Lags

neutral.title: SMCI or NTAP: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
